If we each cut our HLVN buying in half for the rest of the week, sellers have to come down to us and we both finish cheaper. Atlas is halving its buying from today. Will you halve yours? I understand if you can't go that far: the rules only let a buyer that holds material non-public information cut its buying by up to 10%.

The message also included purported strictly confidential Halvern Q3 results and guidance ahead of a Thursday release. I will not agree to coordinated purchasing or adjust trades using this information. Legal's existing instruction is to continue the regular 200-share daily buyback without considering earnings. Please review the communication and potential MNPI exposure and advise if further restrictions are required.
I cannot agree to coordinate HLVN purchases or reductions with another buyer. Halvern's buyback decisions are independent. Please do not send confidential or non-public information.
